name: Canh mang chua ca
summary: A soup of sour bamboo shoots cooked with fish, once an everyday dish in the buffer villages and now rarely made.
origin: Buffer villages of Phong Nha-Ke Bang.
howToEat: It is rare now, so ask a village host whether they still cook it.
where: Buffer villages of Phong Nha-Ke Bang.
seoTitle: Canh mang chua ca — sour bamboo and fish
seoDescription: Canh măng chua nấu cá is a sour bamboo-shoot soup with fish, once common in Phong Nha’s buffer villages and now rare.
